author: Hank Green
description:

Theranos was fraud, of course, but that leads us to the most compelling question...HOW. How did they get so many people to believe...what was it about their story that was so compelling.

Not just one thing, for sure, but one of the things is what I call "The Theranos Trap."

There is only one way out of the Theranos Trap, and that is through understanding. Now, of course, sometimes we need adventurous rebels to ask questions like "What if there was a device you could stick to your skin that knew everything about you and could give you medicine when you need." But we also need normal people who have heard of things to say, "Well, that would be cool, but it's impossible."
